title: questlog activity.jsonl entry
description: ONE line of <projectRoot>/.questlog/activity.jsonl — the CHORE ledger. A chore is a run that declared itself housekeeping rather than road work (card hygiene, a tooling repair, a session resume, a distillation). Chores are recorded HERE and never on roadmap.json, so the road never fills with maintenance noise, and the escape hatch stays countable: the raids panel renders 'today: N chores, M linked, K unlinked' from this file plus the evidence launches. Append-only, one JSON object per line, written under the same per-road lock as roadmap.json, but this is NOT a road file: nothing here changes what the map shows. The idempotency key is (source, ref, kind) — a watcher restart re-observing the same run appends nothing. ABSENT is normal and produces no validator output at all.

ts.description: REQUIRED. When the observation was recorded.

source.description: REQUIRED. Which observer wrote this line. Same enum as a milestone evidence entry.

ref.description: REQUIRED. The run identity: a workflow id (wf_…), a dispatchId, or a log stamp.

kind.description: REQUIRED. launch = the chore began. finish = it ended. abandon = it was dropped. A chore never carries a verdict and is never retracted: nothing on the road depends on it.

label.description: REQUIRED string (may be empty). Plain wording for what the chore was, verbatim from the writer. Never interpreted.
